segments.text: Añāpī Ṭhābhi leśidhā siddhaya Ṭhātmī nāyavagatanti.
There are other powers also to such a yogī, which come in existence, that take place by the glory of this supreme will, this supreme energy of will.
Bhūt-sandhāna, bhūt-pratāktu, viśu-sangatta, plantyat-sūtra.
Bhūt-sandhāna, by the greatness of this achievement of iśashakti, the energy of will, he can do bhūt-sandhāna.
Bhūt-sandhāna means just to concentrate on some particular person, who is sick, who is suffering from pain, sadness, or who is crying.
Just put awareness or focus your awareness of that supreme will to make him leave that sadness.
That is bhūt-sandhāna. This bhūt-sandhāna also takes place to him.
Bhūt-pratāktu, when it is destined that he has to suffer for three years constantly on bed.
Bhūt-pratāktu, he can separate that trouble from his body for the time being and give it in some box.
That is Bhūt-pratāktu. He separates that trouble from his body and he can enjoy nicely and he can work just as we work in daily routine of life.
Without less trouble, but his trouble is there in box, locked.
Whenever he again comes and sleeps and opens the box, that trouble enters in his body and he cries.
So that means he can rise into consciousness and give body here.
Yes, his body is there, doesn't matter? Yes, let body be painful but his consciousness is never painful.
Bhūt-sangata and there is also third power that comes to him, that is Bhūt-sangata.
He can enter in past world and future world also.
The past world has happened. The future world has to come.
You can enter in that world also. Such a yogi can enter. Not everybody. That is Bhūt-sangata.
Deṣikāli, viper-karsase, viśtesu, sangata.
Bhūt-sangata, ni, shiri, riprahan, baāva, dāthma-kanī.
Bhūt-sangata means by Bhūt-sangata, you must know that shiri-ra is Bhūt-sangata,
Brath is Bhūt-sangata and objects are Bhūt-sangata.
These boothas, whenever that kind of yogi focus his will, for api anadau, api anadau in making a particular person recover here or in heaven or in hell.
A particular person who is living or who is dead, who is dead in heaven or in hell, he can make him alright.
He can rise him from that sadness in all the three worlds.
Pariposanam means viadadi upisamadau prasaktam. Viadadi upisamadau prasaktam. Viaddi means pain, pain of body.
Just to get rid of that pain prasaktam. Just separate that pain from body and do your work, what have you to do, what you have to do.
That is shri radya, visualization, just to separate it from your body. That pain, he can do it.
Then shakalaya, viapakrastrasya, visasya, sangata. The world who is viaprakrastrasya, far away by time and space.
In that universe also, you can enter.
Janavishi karitwagika, you can just focus your mind in London and you can see what is happening there.
With these very eyes, that is, we should sangata. Or it is away from space.
Away from time also, you can experience. Time means that what is passed, already passed.
I say, purvakti shaktasandhane, only by aiming on some object by the energy of will.
Aiming or focusing, but as the analogy said, focusing, focusing is better word for this aiming.
This is explained in each and every tantra, in the chapters of sadhanas, not in the chapters of siddhas.
Durbalo pitadakramya yadakkarye pravartati, it is said in spandha, by taking hold of spandha, that is chashakti, the energy of will.
Even the Durbala means a feeble person also, becomes fit to do the aimed work.
The feeble person who cannot walk only two or three sit-ups, by putting force of his chashakti, you can climb the hill.
Durbalo pitadakramya yadakkarye pravartati, he becomes capable and fit to do that work.
Aachadeyat babukhamja tatayyotib babukshata, the one who is filled with hunger, extreme hunger, intensity of hunger.
You can subside hunger by aiming or focusing the force of chashakti of will.
Aachadeyat babukhamja, glaniyar viluntika dehi dehe tasya-cya gyanatastriti, tatunmesh vilum tamcet kutasasiyat ehetuka.
Glaniyar, glaniyar means absence of awareness, and there is absence of awareness, and there is no awareness.
Viluntika dehi, in this body it is viluntika, it steals away all the wealth of spirituality.
It steals away all the wealth of spirituality in your body, but what steals away?
Lack of awareness, absence of awareness.
When there is absence of awareness, take it granted that you are looted, you have no wealth.
Whatever you had, it is gone. There is no awareness.
Glaniyar viluntika dehe tasya-cya agyanatastriti, this absence of awareness is created by your own ignorance.
Tasya-cya-criti, the creation of tasya, the absence of awareness is from ignorance by ignorance.
Tatunmesh vilum tamcet, if you wash off ignorance, but it is existing in you, that is existing in you,
wash off that ignorance by that unmesh, by spandha, by that will kutasasiyat ehetuka.
What is the possibility of absence of awareness to exist?
Absence of awareness won't exist. There will be awareness in full.
Yatah, herthos, suftodristah, saudhane pijetasi, bhuya, suberturu, baati, sabhalo, dhyogubhavita.
Tatah, yat paramarthin, yatri, yatahasitam, tatah, balama, kremya, na, chira, sampravatati.
Just as any object by ordinary people, any object is not vividly seen at first, saudhane pijetasi,
but when he puts awareness on it and sees keenly what the object is, he perceives that object vividly afterwards,
just after a few seconds. First, he perceives that it is positioned there is a rope lying on the ground.
He at first perceives that it is snake, then after perceiving it very well with awareness,
he sees and perceives that it is not snake, it is rope. So, he has well understood the object at that time.
In the same way, tatah, yat paramarthin, yatri, yatahasitam, whatever is existing,
where and wherever any object is existing, any object, object where and whenever is existing there,
tatah, balama, kremya. You have to put only the focusing of your energy of will
and you can perceive that object in a flash and instant.
